overall.verdict: A visually coherent, trust-forward wallet with genuinely excellent bilateral-credit storytelling — the before/after payment bars, dispute flow and Sovereignty screen are best-in-class. It is held back by jargon leaks (entity ids, collateral tariffs, basis points), cross-screen number and color-semantic inconsistencies, and two overloaded flows (cross-network swap, Assets) that would strand non-expert users.
priority_fixes: Split the cross-network swap (05b) into a two-step wizard with consistent slider/preset state and a single sequenced CTA
Rebuild 12-assets into distinct Faucets / Credit / Claim sections; remove the credit-extension panel from the faucet flow
Adopt one risk-color and wording standard for uncovered exposure (amber + 'not covered if the hub vanishes') across Home, Account and Sovereignty, and reconcile the $0 vs $60 collateral contradiction
Replace raw addresses, entity ids and 'frames/inbound room/lot rounding' jargon with truncated values, tooltips and plain-language labels
Restructure Settings into sub-navigated sections and move runtime diagnostics and vault destruction behind friction
